# dist

`Zeldas Errands 0.1.o2r` - the mod archive (built by `tools/make_art.py`):

- `alt/scenes/shared/spot01_scene/spot01_sceneTex_012B50` - the sign over
  Kakariko's gate, repainted WELCOME HARVIE (4x resolution, raw RGBA32)
- `textures/zeldas_errands/gWelcomeHarvieCardTex` - the "Welcome, Harvie!"
  title card (IA8 144x24, the size of the game's own place cards)

The filename stays at 0.1 on purpose: SoH remembers enabled mods by filename,
so renaming it would silently switch the mod off on the device.
